title: Centeno Elementary Honors Veterans With Parade, Ceremony and Lunch
excerpt: Centeno Elementary welcomed veterans and their families for its annual Veterans Day celebration: a parade through the school, a ceremony in the gym, and lunch together.
content:
Centeno Elementary School in United ISD welcomed veterans and their loved ones for its annual Veterans Day celebration, a parade around the school followed by a ceremony in the gymnasium and lunch together, the district reported Nov. 13.

American flags waved and patriotic music filled the hallways as students welcomed the veterans for a celebration that began with a traditional parade around the school. Students lined the halls and waved tiny flags with pride and excitement, and their Veterans Day artwork decorated the hallways. Veterans walked alongside their family members along a route lined by an entire campus eager to recognize their service.

After the parade, guests gathered in the gymnasium for a ceremony featuring the school's GEMS dancers, choir and National Elementary Honor Society members. Through dance, song, historical reflections and a poem, students paid tribute to America's veterans, past and present, while learning more about the meaning of their service.

Principal Cynthia Sierra said the tradition has taken place for several years as a way to thank veterans and surround them with appreciation and love from the school community. “We want our veterans to feel the love and appreciation of our entire school,” Sierra said.

School counselors Angelica Charles and Myrna Canales helped organize the celebration. Invitations were shared with students' families, encouraging them to bring parents, grandparents and friends who are veterans. Families also had the opportunity to submit photographs and information about their veterans so they could receive recognition during the program.

After the ceremony, veterans enjoyed lunch, snacks and time with their loved ones at tables arranged for the gathering. Families were also welcome to bring their own food, making the afternoon an opportunity to share a meal and create memories together.

Veterans Day, observed each Nov. 11, honors all who have served in the United States Armed Forces, in wartime and in peace.
